## Why

Kit A landed the structural vocabulary; kit B is the epistemic half —
the components that carry the record's honesty: a value's contested
state, a disagreement's shape, an absence's kind and what the reader
can do about it, the provenance behind a claim, and the typed states
that explain what is missing. Several pieces existed in primitive
form (the marker, the range, the banner); this row finishes them to
the K14 contract — two agreement levels, labelled dots, one
actionable absence chip, one provenance shell, the closed callout
vocabulary, and every empty cause mountable by contract.

## What ships

### Contested + contradiction (`SIG-UI-008/009`, J3)

- **`ContestedMarker.astro`** — now distinguishes the two contested
  agreement levels it can render: `CONTESTED` ("Contested") and
  `IRRECONCILABLE` ("Unresolved", the §29 state where no value can be
  defended) — the same ≠ glyph but a different lexicon label plus a
  solid outline, so the states read apart in greyscale too
  (SIG-UI-005). `href` makes the marker a plain GET link to the
  both-sides surface — J3's "both sides one click away"; wired on
  `/evidence/[id]/` to the page's own `#conflicting-claims` list.
- **`ContradictionRange.astro`** — names its agreement level
  ("Contested range" / "Unresolved range"; the unresolved figure
  keeps the solid raspberry frame) and labels **one dot per claim**
  with an ordinal tying the mark to its row in the accessible claims
  list; the different-quantity note stays visible (§29.1).

### Absence (`SIG-UI-007`, O4)

- **`AbsenceChip.astro`** — the actionable absence marker: the ONE
  shared `sig-absence-hatch` texture carrying the kind's distinct
  symbol + short label, a ⓘ that opens the kind's plain-language
  meaning in a UA-native `popover` (the no-JS pattern), and
  **"Help find it ›"** — a plain GET link to where the gap becomes
  work: the research queue by default, or a real `/task/<handle>/`
  page when the caller names one (never a mock generated-task page —
  P34.12's retirement stands). `/map/` mounts the chip on every
  unlocated record in its no-JS list; `AbsenceHatch.astro` keeps the
  bare hatch but now carries the kind symbol so the four kinds read
  apart by symbol + text, never a second texture.

### Provenance (`SIG-UI-083`)

- **`ProvenancePanelShell.astro`** — the Astro shell over TX-08a's
  `sig.provenance-panel/1`: it does exactly one thing — resolve the
  single renderer (`ProvenancePanel.tsx`; the conformance test still
  fails on a second `data-provenance-panel` emitter). The .tsx is the
  single module importing the panel stylesheet
  (`styles/provenance.css`), so shell and island mounts render the
  identical contract identically. `/evidence/[id]/` and `/network/`
  migrate to the shell.

### Callouts + incompleteness

- **`lib/callouts.ts` — `sig.callout/1` + `Callout.astro`** — the
  closed kind vocabulary `note` · `caution` · `known_issue`;
  `caution` is the only kind that may carry the provisional amber
  accent. An unknown kind throws at build (SIG-ENG-042); the kind
  labels are batch-tracked copy (`data-copy` → `CK-62/63/64`).
- **Incompleteness banner** — `IncompletenessBanner.astro` already
  computed the honest count and categorised unknowns; the harness now
  mounts it and the e2e leg pins the neutrality rule ("absence of a
  row is not evidence of absence") plus a non-zero real count.

### Typed empties + errors (`SIG-UI-086/151`)

- **`EmptyState.astro`** — accepts either a named `surface` or a
  fully-typed `parts` contract so the non-absence cause classes
  (`filtered_none` / `not_redistributable` / `degraded`) — which have
  no aggregate surface yet — mount by contract; one of the two is
  required (fail closed, never an untyped state). The hatch still
  renders only for real absence causes.
- **Branded error states** — the harness mounts all four
  `sig.error-page/1` kinds (not_found · refused · removed ·
  server_error): five parts, the search · home · status recovery
  trio, and **no hatch** — an error is not an absence.

## Deviations (recorded in `docs/build/runs/P36.23.md`)

The single-emitter conformance leg scans comments too — the shell's
docstring reworded; the glued-text sweep (K14 NEW-7) caught the
popover→help-link boundary, fixed with an explicit separator; four
allow-list entries exempt the harness's new fixture hrefs; an Astro
frontmatter fragment literal was inlined (JSX `<>` cannot be assigned
in frontmatter); **no ADR** — every shape executes already-answered
decision lines (K14 §3.4/§4.6, K13 §7 W1/J3/O4, TX-08a, UXR-33/36,
SIG-UI-007/008/009/012): contracts are web-internal lib modules, no
new public route, no T2 surface, no script, no runtime dependency.
